action.content: Can you write a poem about the pros and cons of playing a lot of video games? Please make sure it's at least 40 sentences long (don't forget to add punctuations). You must highlight some words or phrases in your response, like *highlighted phrase*.
action.label: context

action.content:
[DRAFT]
The screen glows bright with colors that can **captivate the soul**.
We press a button and a world begins to **unfold before our eyes**.
Heroes rise to fight the dark in battles that are **never truly lost**.
Our fingers dance across the keys with **speed and rhythmic grace**.
It feels like magic when the character **defeats the final boss**.
We laugh aloud at jokes that only **friends online can share**.
The stories told are vast and **deep enough to explore forever**.
We learn new skills and **strategies that help us grow**.
It is a place where we can **escape the mundane world** for a while.
The challenges faced make our minds **sharper and more focused**.
We build communities that **span across the entire globe**.
Sometimes we feel a sense of **belonging that we lack elsewhere**.
The graphics are stunning and **more realistic than ever before**.
We can travel to places that **no human has ever seen**.
The music swells and **fills the room with emotion**.
It is a safe space where **mistakes do not have real consequences**.
We can try again and again until we **finally get it right**.
The sense of achievement is **pure and incredibly satisfying**.
We connect with people who **understand our unique interests**.
The games evolve and **offer new content constantly**.
We can customize our avatars to **look exactly how we want**.
The immersion is so deep that **time seems to disappear**.
We forget about our worries and **lose ourselves in the quest**.
It is a form of art that **continues to evolve rapidly**.
We can experience different cultures and **historical events through play**.
The problem starts when we **play for too many hours**.
Our eyes begin to **strain from staring at the light**.
Our backs ache from **sitting in one position too long**.
We neglect our real friends and **family members at home**.
Our grades or work start to **suffer from the distraction**.
We lose track of time and **miss important meals or events**.
The money spent on games can **add up to a fortune**.
We might feel **lonely even when surrounded by players**.
The competitive nature can **lead to toxic behavior sometimes**.
We become **addicted to the dopamine hits** the game provides.
Our sleep patterns get **completely disrupted by late nights**.
We ignore our physical health and **stop exercising our bodies**.
The virtual world can **replace real-world interactions entirely**.
We might develop **unrealistic expectations of life itself**.
The frustration of losing can **cause genuine anger and stress**.
We worry about **what happens when the server shuts down**.
The cycle of playing and **stopping becomes a difficult habit**.
We need to find a **balance between fun and responsibility**.
The pros are clear but the **cons can be quite severe**.
We must remember that **games are meant to be a hobby**.
Not a replacement for the **richness of real human connection**.
We should set limits so that **we can enjoy life fully**.
The screen is a window but **not the only view we need**.
We can have the best of both worlds if we **play with intention and care**.
Let us choose to **play wisely and live well**.
